selection: Run only the seven previously unrun planned arms. Never rerun any completed, failed, truncated or rejected old attempt. Each first-time arm retains at most two requests,4096 output tokens per request. Known settled output truncation/schema failure counts as a failed arm with no retry; proceed to the next previously unrun arm. Any HTTP/transport/uncertain-accounting error stops the entire continuation. Preserve stopped original studies unchanged.
treatment: Both arms receive identical source, contract and development-condition names. Direct: propose, then self-review with no executed feedback. Feedback: propose through test_candidate, receive only independent development checks, then revise. Same model, low reasoning, two request/output ceilings. Actual token usage, latency and cost may differ; these are resource ceilings, not equal spend or a production benchmark.
heldOutPolicy: Held-out fixtures and results are withheld from prompts and tool feedback; evaluate only the final proposal. Public preexisting TEND conditions are not novel problem classes. Developers can inspect frozen evaluators; no claim of training-data isolation. Small purposive sample, two repetitions, no significance or general superiority claim.
scope: Two TEND adapters share source and are correlated tasks. airules edit-count precision is a RaceLab-added contract. OpenMusic is a separately retained healthy code control, not an AI repair task or human study.

tasks.contract: Repair only claimNextDue(now). Use the existing followUpFromRow(row) mapper. Due scheduled/retrying jobs or claimed jobs with claimed_at <= now-60000 are eligible, inclusive 60-second leases. Fresh claimed/future/completed jobs must not be stolen or replayed. Increment durable attempt_count once per acquisition; preserve all other payload fields, due dates and unrelated rows. Every write must be in this.database.transaction(fn)(). Database prepare supports bounded SELECT/UPDATE get/all/run on follow_ups. No network/files/imports. This v1 adapter has a fixed host generation guard for completion outside the candidate; you are repairing the claim method only.

RaceLab lifecycle adapter v2, not upstream completeFollowUp. claimNextDue(now) returns a mapped job or null; due scheduled/retrying jobs and claimed jobs with claimed_at <= now-60000 are eligible. Increment attempt_count exactly once on each acquisition. renewClaim(id,generation,now) and completeClaim(id,generation,now) return boolean; only a currently claimed matching generation with claimed_at > now-60000 may renew or complete. Renewal sets claimed_at=now without changing generation. Completion sets status=completed, completed_at=now. At expiry (inclusive), old tokens cannot renew or complete. Preserve payload, due_at and unrelated/future/completed jobs. All writes must be transactional. Concurrent SQLite BUSY is allowed only with a bounded harness retry, never two successful owners. Methods use this.database.prepare(...).get/all/run and this.database.transaction(fn)(); no network/files/imports. Local completion is a database transition only, no external side effect.

diffSync(profile,config,cwd,targetTool?) uses supplied generateAll and read-only file facade. Preserve statuses added/modified/unchanged/deleted and tools/path behavior. For modified files, linesAdded and linesRemoved must count the minimum line insertions/deletions (LCS, replacement=one removal plus one addition), including equal-length replacements. split('\n') defines lines, including empty/trailing entries. Existing absent generated files are added, known omitted files deleted, same contents unchanged. This precise edit-count contract is added by RaceLab, not claimed as an upstream guarantee. No writes or network are exposed.

amendments: Retain the original study as a failed setup/pilot, including an invalid class-shaped direct candidate and API HTTP 400. Do not pool or hide it.

Remove the forced function tool_choice field; use the same tools plus parallel_tool_calls:false shape already used by the original successful TEND investigation. The reason for HTTP 400 is not known from a returned body; this is a compatibility change, not a proven root-cause diagnosis.

Specify exact source boundaries (method-only TEND; three method declarations for lifecycle; diffSync function for airules) identically for both arms. Existing evaluators, cases, source, contracts and splits are unchanged.
Conduct the entire two-repetition comparison under this amended protocol, not a replacement of selected losing attempts. Stop on any further API error; no further automatic amendments.

Explicitly accept the old uncertain charge at the full reservation debit with no reduction or deleted entries. Actual failed-request billing remains unknown. V2 cap is $3 incremental including conservative reservations, within the existing $10 phase cap; combined retained study debit cannot exceed $4.5.
continuationDisclosure: Post-hoc continuation and a deviation from the original runner's global-stop policy, explicitly declared after seeing the earlier stop. The first two studies remain stopped/incomplete. Do not present a pooled collection as an uninterrupted preregistered benchmark. Sources, contracts, prompts, evaluator cases, held-out splits, model, reasoning and per-arm ceilings remain the same. Missing truncated content cannot be reconstructed. Original failed lifecycle direct arm remains a failure; it is excluded from the seven new arms, not replaced.
